Lena: Heads-up 10: we need a concise battlecard update for the 'inbound routing' play (targeting infra teams evaluating managed endpoints vs private/dedicated infra). Goal: one-pager + AE CSV + webinar slide.
Marco: Key buyer questions: 1) How do you guarantee tail latency? 2) How to compare unit cost vs spot-managed? 3) How do rollouts & versioning work across private vs hosted?
Ravi: For tail latency: 'Dedicated pools + workload-aware batching + KV prefix caching keep p95 predictable; automatic fallback to compatible smaller variants during hot tails.' Short line for AE: 'Predictable SLOs, not surprise spikes.'
Jules: Cost line: 'Dynamic batching + quant profiles cut per-token by ~60% on convo workloads; committed Dedicated pricing removes burst surcharge.' Add a sample calc for $/MM tokens.
Bianca: AE CSV should have columns: objection,rebuttal,proof_snippet,asset_link,routing_tag. We'll feed routing_tag into lead-scoring.
Theo: Webinar idea: live demo with a synthetic spike showing p95 for managed vs Dedicated + private. I can script a run and capture graphs. infra-bot: Deploy job queued: perf/loadtest-run-175555 at 22:00Z.
Lena: Great. @Ravi can you write 3 TL;DR variations (customer-focused, technical, and exec)?
Ravi: Customer-focused: 'Keep product latency consistent even during usage spikes.'
Ravi: Technical: 'Dedicated GPU pools + KV caching and model-variant fallback reduce tail latency without sacrificing throughput.'
Ravi: Exec: 'Predictable inference economics and SLAs that make LLM features reliable for customers.'
Marco: Add compliance micro-rebuttal: 'Private deployment offers VPC, KMS/HSM integrations, local audit logs, and optional on-prem air-gapped package.'
Bianca: Also include a one-sentence "how to demo" per row, e.g., 'Trigger 10x query spike & show p95 graph, then flip routing to Dedicated.'
Lena: Timeline: draft one-pager and CSV by Wednesday EOD; webinar slide deck draft by Thursday. Who's owned?
Marco: I'll own the one-pager.
Bianca: I'll produce the CSV and AE cheat sheet.
Theo: I'll run the load and upload screenshots + Grafana URLs. infra-bot: Load run succeeded: artifacts: https://ci.redwood/load/175555/artifacts
Jules: For sales soundbite: 'We help teams ship features faster by removing inference as an operational variable.'
Lena: Nice. Add a short proof line to each rebuttal linking to the benchmark artifacts.
Ravi: Quick pasteable snippet for docs:
```
Objection: "Why not just use ProviderY's managed endpoints?"
Rebuttal: "Managed endpoints can show unpredictable tail-latency under multi-tenant bursts. Redwood Dedicated + caching and model-variant fallbacks deliver consistent p95s, plus Private when data governance requires it."
Proof: https://ci.redwood/load/175555/artifacts/p95-comparison.png
```
Bianca: CSV template done and uploaded to /marketing/ops/inbound-routing/csvs.
Marco: One-pager draft in /marketing/drafts/battlecards/inbound-routing-dedicated-vs-managed.md.
Lena: Perfect. We'll review in tomorrow's standup and finalize copy for the webinar. Thanks everyone. :sparkles:
